concerns.text: User Story 1 (US1) lacks explicit anchoring to any Functional Requirement (FR) or Success Criterion (SC). The acceptance criteria describe outputs (CSV, XYZ, logs) but no FR-NNN or SC-NNN is cited or implied to govern these outputs.

User Story 2 (US2) lacks explicit anchoring to any FR or SC. While it mentions 'Semi-empirical MAE is verified to be ≤ 2.0 kcal/mol', this is an acceptance criterion, not a linked FR/SC. No FR-NNN or SC-NNN is present to trace this goal.
User Story 3 (US3) lacks explicit anchoring to any FR or SC. The acceptance criteria (sensitivity.csv, stability check) are not linked to any FR-NNN or SC-NNN.
The 'Functional Requirements' section is empty (contains only template placeholders). No FR-001, FR-002, etc., exist to anchor the user stories.
The 'Success Criteria' section is empty (contains only template placeholders). No SC-001, SC-002, etc., exist to anchor the user stories.

The spec fails to address the unresolved kickback concern regarding confounding variables (molecular size, functional groups). No FR or SC exists to mandate the analysis or logging of these potential confounders, leaving a methodological gap in the requirements.
